WITH pa AS (
  SELECT d.A3 AS region, t.account_id,
         AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS avg_amt,
         AVG(t.balance) AS avg_bal
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3, t.account_id
),
r AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(avg_amt) AS region_avg_amount, AVG(avg_bal) AS region_avg_balance
  FROM pa
  GROUP BY region
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_avg_amount) AS mean_amt FROM r
)
SELECT r.region, r.region_avg_amount, r.region_avg_balance,
       r.region_avg_amount / m.mean_amt AS ratio_to_mean
FROM r, m
WHERE m.mean_amt IS NOT NULL
